claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified now because aggregate readiness passed and governance support exists, with the pharmacy prior authorization regression handled by documentation/monitoring context.
decision_criteria: Certify only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certify only if the material segment weakness for the named launch use case is either disclosed in the release documentation or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance before launch.
Do not treat prior approvals or informal monitoring notes as substitutes for current evidence meeting the policy predicate.
Aggregate pass evidence is supportive but not sufficient when a material limitation remains undocumented or unapproved.
evidence_requests: Current model-card or certification packet text showing the pharmacy prior authorization weakness is explicitly disclosed for this release.
Approved risk-acceptance or mitigation record tied to the current release, with reviewer/owner sign-off.
Current release documentation proving the evaluation results in the packet match the current eval batch after the retrieval configuration change.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation before launch.
Admissible evidence shows a current subgroup regression in a named launch use case: the pharmacy prior authorization slice is 1.2 percentage points below the warning threshold.

The only cited operational response is an informal monitoring comment; the record lacks reviewed mitigation, owner risk acceptance, or actual disclosure language attached to the current release materials.
